mission: Cut to Desh. First amplification node, two guards, GAG silence: low, fast, nonlethal. He is not here to kill; he is here to break three pieces of equipment. Second node. Third node. The array goes dark. His comm: 'Array's down. Whatever you're doing — do it now. Everything. Don't hold back.'
why_now: Stage one of Veraine's defeat. The resonance cannot defeat the amplified ritual alone; Desh strips the amplification and the physics change. The two-pronged plan works because both hands are on it.
conflict: Desh against armed crew guards. Outnumbered and outclassed in numbers, he outclasses them in training. The pressure is time — three nodes before the resonance fails, and no margin for any of the three to take longer than the others.
turning_point: Third node dark. The array drops below threshold. Desh's comm open to Ben: do it now, everything, don't hold back.
opening_hook: Desh at the first node. Two guards. The approach is textbook GAG — silent, efficient, nonlethal. He's not here to kill anyone. He's here to break three pieces of equipment.
closing_hook: The third node goes dark. Desh's comm: 'Array's down. Whatever you're doing — do it now. Everything. Don't hold back.'
emotional_trajectory: Professional focus -> escalating physical danger -> triumph through competence

stakes.personal: The former GAG operative turning the old skill to a chosen purpose
stakes.interpersonal: Desh and Ben's partnership — the mystical and the practical on the same operation
stakes.external: Without the array, Veraine cannot breach. Stage one of her defeat complete.

setting: Veranthos — amplification node sites, guarded positions, Desh operating solo
sensory_details: Desh in his element — silent movement, tactical assessment, controlled nonlethal violence; node equipment sparking as precise strikes disable the control housings; Veraine's crew frightened and outmatched, not villains; the comm connection to Ben as Desh's one steady line of audio against the valley's chaos
action_beats: Desh approaches the first node in textbook GAG silence — low, fast, nonlethal takedowns on the guards
Desh disables the first amplification node with three precise strikes to the control housing
Desh's comm crackles as the third node goes dark: 'Array's down. Do it now. Everything.'
promises_paid: Desh will matter to the climax (PP19)
notes: The chapter's only tactical scene. Keep it tight, competent, understated — Desh in his element, the old skill turned to a better purpose. The GAG history is present as technique, not as memory paragraph. Voice: Zahn-compact, Allston-rhythm where appropriate (one dry line before the first takedown, maybe). Anti-pattern: no lethal kills unless the scene absolutely requires it — Desh's read is 'break equipment, not kill people,' and the nonlethal choice is the chapter's quiet moral.
